_comment: The observable-indicator register on /remote-workers/red-flags/. Kept short: only observations that are hard to explain innocently, not every service an operation touches. One line per row plus its sources; the reports carry the explanation, so the page links to them rather than paraphrasing. Sources are keyed into `sources` so each is written once; src/_data/sources.js resolves them into the site-wide registry.

indicators.indicator: The shipping address changes after hire
indicators.detail: Often to another state, with a family emergency as the reason

indicators.indicator: Camera off, or a face that does not match the profile
indicators.detail: Or text chat in place of a video call

indicators.indicator: A small staffing vendor vouching for the candidate
indicators.detail: The vendor itself can be the front

indicators.indicator: A contractor role, fully remote
indicators.detail: Avoids in-person onboarding

indicators.indicator: A senior engineer with a long U.S. history and a template CV
indicators.detail: Software, full-stack or blockchain

indicators.indicator: Working hours that fit East Asia, not the claimed location
A work history with no U.S. employers
indicators.detail: Written into the persona prompt so references cannot be checked domestically

indicators.indicator: Recommends other candidates once hired
indicators.detail: Common among genuine hires; SEAL reports it used to place more workers

indicators.indicator: Accepts a rate well below market without negotiating
indicators.detail: SEAL cites a 25 to 50 percent discount

indicators.indicator: Output that swings sharply from one week to the next
indicators.detail: Consistent with one seat shared by several workers

indicators.indicator: The CV's work history does not appear on GitHub
indicators.detail: No commits or repositories from the employers it names

indicators.indicator: A hardware KVM on the issued machine
indicators.detail: PiKVM, TinyPilot, GLKVM

indicators.indicator: An EDID emulator or dummy HDMI plug
indicators.detail: Fitted alongside the KVM

indicators.indicator: North Korean internal-network clients on the machine
indicators.detail: NetKey, OConnect

indicators.indicator: Remote-access software on the corporate endpoint
indicators.detail: RustDesk, AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Google Remote Desktop

indicators.indicator: Conferencing remote control used as the access path
indicators.detail: Zoom or Webex remote control; the Zoom artifact saveUserDisclaimer

indicators.indicator: A virtual desktop or personal device in place of a shipped laptop
indicators.detail: BYOD access through a virtual machine

indicators.indicator: The endpoint or SASE agent disabled by the employee
Anti-idle or mouse-jiggling software
indicators.detail: Keeps an unattended laptop showing as active

indicators.indicator: Unrelated employees signing in from one address
indicators.detail: A laptop farm's shared line

indicators.indicator: Astrill VPN exit addresses
indicators.detail: About 2,400 published by Spur; also hosting ranges or a country other than the claimed one

indicators.indicator: A proxy server on a United States VPS fronting the whole team
indicators.detail: CCProxy, HTTP and SOCKS5 with per-user authentication

indicators.indicator: One identity in sessions from two countries at once
Residential proxy egress near the address of record
indicators.detail: IPRoyal and comparable services

indicators.indicator: An Android emulator answering a verification challenge
indicators.detail: LDPlayer, with ShareX capturing the QR code off the screen

indicators.indicator: A virtual camera in place of a physical one
indicators.detail: VCAM, OBS virtual camera

indicators.indicator: A persona photograph that has been face-swapped or generated
indicators.detail: faceswapper.ai, instant-portrait.com

indicators.indicator: A history of changing legal names
indicators.detail: Identity rotation across documents and accounts

indicators.indicator: One person's voice on another person's call
indicators.detail: Voicemeeter Banana routing audio between two machines in the same meeting

indicators.indicator: References who are other personas
indicators.detail: Assigned in advance in the identity dossier

indicators.indicator: Teammates assisting a live interview off camera
indicators.detail: Three behind one caller, with live transcription

indicators.indicator: Different people attending as the same employee
indicators.detail: Client meetings handed between operatives

indicators.indicator: Scripted answers read aloud
indicators.detail: An answer bank carrying phonetic pronunciation guides

indicators.indicator: A CV fitted too exactly to the job requirement
indicators.detail: Written within hours of the requirement being shared

indicators.indicator: A biography rehearsed on an AI interview tool
indicators.detail: ChatGPT script, MockWise practice

indicators.indicator: A different GitHub, email or social profile visible on a shared screen
indicators.detail: Not the one the CV gives

indicators.indicator: Resigns and blocks every account rather than send a verification selfie
indicators.detail: Asked for a photograph taken where the candidate claims to live

indicators.indicator: Can't speak their claimed native language
indicators.detail: A candidate presenting as Japanese, asked in Japanese

indicators.indicator: Refuses to repeat a phrase critical of Kim Jong Un
indicators.detail: And ends the call rather than say it

indicators.indicator: A stock video background, often the Golden Gate Bridge
indicators.detail: The backdrop recurs across unrelated candidates

indicators.indicator: Keeps avoiding in-person meetings
indicators.detail: Repeated excuses, and reluctance to accept a promotion or an on-site invitation

indicators.indicator: One-time codes relayed by someone else
indicators.detail: The second factor sits with a facilitator, who posts codes in team chat

indicators.indicator: Multi-factor codes generated in a browser
indicators.detail: 2fa.live and comparable sites

indicators.indicator: A professional-network session moved between machines
indicators.detail: The Cookie-Editor extension, used to import LinkedIn session cookies

indicators.indicator: A forwarding rule pointing outside the persona
indicators.detail: Configured before the account is handed over

indicators.indicator: LinkedIn or GitHub accounts a few months old
indicators.detail: Against a decade of claimed experience

indicators.indicator: Accounts stood up on bulk verification services
indicators.detail: sms-man.com, sms-activate.org, mailforspam.com

indicators.indicator: A VoIP line in place of a carrier number
indicators.detail: Google Voice, slynumber.com, hushed.com; Skype historically

indicators.indicator: The address on the CV is not the address that applied
indicators.detail: An older address on the resume PDF, a fresh Gmail on the application

indicators.indicator: An anti-detect browser holding one profile per persona
indicators.detail: ixBrowser, each profile behind its own proxy

indicators.indicator: A GitHub account created after the commits it hosts
indicators.detail: Years of history predate the account, often cloned with the .git author data edited

indicators.indicator: A sudden change of name or GitHub handle, or deleted social accounts
indicators.detail: Especially after questions start

indicators.indicator: A pull request pushed from a different account than usual
indicators.detail: Another worker on the same seat

indicators.indicator: A dormant or taken-over account that suddenly builds activity
indicators.detail: Often about two years of history before the first application

indicators.indicator: Company source code pushed to personal repositories
indicators.detail: Precedes extortion when a placement ends

indicators.indicator: Company source code cloned to a personal computer or cloud account
indicators.detail: Repositories copied off company systems to a machine or account the worker controls

indicators.indicator: Password notes and broad file browsing
Pay split or redirected after hire
indicators.detail: To a third party, a wallet, an account in another name, or through a "manager"

indicators.indicator: Payroll into a stablecoin-backed virtual account
indicators.detail: HuruPay and comparable services

indicators.indicator: A corp-to-corp engagement through an entity formed around an American
indicators.detail: A certificate of formation and a W-9 where an I-9 and a licence would be

indicators.indicator: Asks to be paid in cryptocurrency

priorities.1: Hard to explain innocently. Escalate on this alone.
priorities.2: Strong. Investigate, and look for a second signal.
priorities.3: Common on its own. Counts only alongside others.
